name: logang-bot
description: Personal engineering conventions packaged as installable plugins: platform-specific rules, language-agnostic code style, and release workflow.

plugins.name: general-code-style
plugins.description: Language-agnostic style rules for file, class, and function size, parameter counts, self-describing names, and comment discipline. Ships a style reviewer agent and a size-check hook.

plugins.name: android-compose
plugins.description: Android, Kotlin, and Jetpack Compose conventions: composable structure, previews, navigation routes, string resources, and clean-architecture use cases.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Release and documentation workflow: two-file changelog discipline, docs upkeep, and a hook that keeps git write commands in the developer's hands.
